segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to HSS Study Guide.
segments.zh: 朋友们好，欢迎来到 HSE Study Guide。

segments.text: In this video, we are going to learn how to inspect the welding machine.
segments.zh: 这期视频我们要学习怎样检查电焊机。

segments.text: So let's start the video.
segments.zh: 那我们开始吧。

segments.text: So friends, this is the welding machine in front of you.
segments.zh: 朋友们，你们面前的这台就是电焊机。

segments.text: Whenever a new welding machine comes on our side,
segments.zh: 每当有新的电焊机运到我们这边，

segments.text: or if an old welding machine comes from the other side,
segments.zh: 或者有旧的电焊机从别的地方调过来，

segments.text: then we have to inspect that welding machine before bringing it to work.
segments.zh: 我们都要在投入使用之前检查这台电焊机。

segments.text: So let's go. Now we know the point wise that when we have to inspect the welding machine,
segments.zh: 那我们开始。现在我们逐条来了解，检查电焊机的时候，

segments.text: we have to check the points in it.
segments.zh: 要检查它的哪些要点。

segments.text: So the first point is that we have to check in that welding machine that there is an on-off knob.
segments.zh: 第一点，我们要检查电焊机上有没有开关旋钮，

segments.text: That is, we have to check if the switch of the on-off is there or not.
segments.zh: 也就是要检查有没有通断开关，

segments.text: And we have to check that there should be no damage,
segments.zh: 还要检查它有没有损坏，

segments.text: it should be in good condition and it should be properly insulated.
segments.zh: 是否状况良好，绝缘是否良好。

segments.text: Then we have to check that the regulator in the welding machine
segments.zh: 然后要检查电焊机上的调节器，

segments.text: with which the indicator is provided or not is also checked.
segments.zh: 看它是否配有指示器，这一点也要检查。

segments.text: Then we have to check that the welding cables that we connect with the welding machine,
segments.zh: 然后要检查连接到电焊机上的焊接电缆，

segments.text: so that when we attach the welding cables to the welding machine,
segments.zh: 也就是把焊接电缆接到电焊机上的时候，

segments.text: then the joints that are there, whether they are stuck or not,
segments.zh: 那些接头是否接牢，

segments.text: we have to check that too.
segments.zh: 这一点也要检查。

segments.text: Then we have to check that the insulation of the welding cables
segments.zh: 然后要检查焊接电缆的绝缘层

segments.text: should not be damaged on it, we have to check that.
segments.zh: 有没有损坏，这一点要检查。

segments.text: Then we have to check that the holder of the electrode rod
segments.zh: 然后要检查焊条夹钳

segments.text: and the holder of the earthen, there should be no damage
segments.zh: 和接地夹钳有没有损坏，

segments.text: and it should be in good condition, we have to check that.
segments.zh: 是否状况良好，这一点要检查。

segments.text: Then we have to check that the welding machine
segments.zh: 然后要检查电焊机

segments.text: which we attach power supply in it,
segments.zh: 接电源的时候，

segments.text: then we have to check that it should be used
segments.zh: 要检查它是否使用

segments.text: for the industrial type plug for power supply.
segments.zh: 工业型插头来接电源。

segments.text: Then we have to check that the internal live electrical parts
segments.zh: 然后要检查电焊机内部的带电部件

segments.text: of the welding machine should not be exposed,
segments.zh: 有没有外露，

segments.text: it should be fully covered, we have to check that.
segments.zh: 应该完全遮盖住，这一点要检查。

segments.text: Then we have to check that for the welding machine
segments.zh: 然后要检查电焊机

segments.text: it should be used for 30 mA ALCB.
segments.zh: 是否使用了 30 mA 的漏电断路器。

segments.text: Then we have to check that the trolley of the welding machine
segments.zh: 然后要检查电焊机的小推车，

segments.text: should not be damaged on the trolley,
segments.zh: 推车有没有损坏，

segments.text: we have to check that.
segments.zh: 这一点要检查。

segments.text: So all these points are to be checked
segments.zh: 所以这些要点都是

segments.text: when we inspect the welding machine.
segments.zh: 检查电焊机时要检查的。

segments.text: So friends, I hope that you have come to know
segments.zh: 朋友们，希望你们通过这期视频

segments.text: through this video that how we can inspect the welding machine.
segments.zh: 了解到了怎样检查电焊机。

segments.text: So that's all for today's video,
segments.zh: 今天的视频就到这里，

segments.text: with a new topic, till then take care, bye-bye.
segments.zh: 下期带着新的主题再见，在那之前请多保重，拜拜。
